title: Certificates of Deposit: which post-grace renewals are priced as same-tier Automatic Renewals
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Certificates of Deposit certificate at the end of its grace period. It fixes which maturity instruction a renewal requires, and which renewals are priced under the same-tier renewal pricing rules.

## Rule

1. **Instruction.** A certificate renews only under the Automatic Renewal instruction, and only on a tier that makes Automatic Renewal available.
2. **Same tier only.** The same-tier renewal pricing applies when the tier the certificate renews into, its renewal tier, is the tier the certificate already holds. A renewal into a different tier is outside it.
3. **Target tier.** The target tier whose published standard rates a renewal follows is the tier the certificate renews into: its renewal tier when the owner made no term change during grace, and otherwise the tier the owner chose during grace.

## Condition table

| Maturity instruction on record | Tier makes Automatic Renewal available | Renewal tier is the tier already held | Priced under the same-tier renewal rules? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Automatic Renewal | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Automatic Renewal | Yes | No | No, a renewal into a different tier is outside them |
| A payout or mail-a-check instruction | Any | Any | No, a certificate renews only under Automatic Renewal |

## Cases (drawn from the tier names)

- A 12-Month Certificate on Automatic Renewal whose renewal tier is the 12-Month Certificate renews into the tier it holds, so its renewal is in scope.
- A certificate whose renewal tier is a tier other than the one it holds renews into a different tier, so its renewal is out of scope here, whatever its instruction.

## Points of judgement

**The certificate's instruction pays the balance out to checking. Can a renewal be booked under these rules?**
No. A certificate renews only under the Automatic Renewal instruction.
